concept.hr: Maska dijeli adresu na mrežni i host dio i odlučuje je li odredište blizu
concept.en: The mask splits an address into network and host part and decides near or far

summary.hr: Bitovno I adrese i maske: mrežna i broadcast adresa, broj adresa za uređaje, je li odredište u istoj mreži i kome ide ARP zahtjev.
summary.en: Address AND mask, bit by bit: network and broadcast address, addresses left for hosts, whether a destination is local, and whom ARP asks.
